name: Camuy (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Green field with a white wavy band across the centre for the Río Camuy, interrupted in the middle by the Taíno sun of Camuy in yellow and black.
history: Camuy is a town and municipality on the north coast of Puerto Rico. The green stands for the pastures and vegetation, the interrupted white band for the Río Camuy, which runs underground through the Camuy caves, and the sun for the Taíno petroglyph of Camuy.
